summary: Integrated BioPharma, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing credit facility with PNC Bank. The amendment extends the revolving line of credit expiration to April 14, 2027, maintains the $4 million borrowing limit, and replaces a matured $500,000 convertible equipment note with a new $250,000 convertible equipment line of credit. The new note bears interest at one-month SOFR plus 250 basis points, convertible at PNC's option. This is a routine refinancing of a credit facility with no equity offering, merger, or control change. The filing does not constitute a special situation.
